description.value: Once per day, when you roll a natural 1 on a check, attack roll, or saving throw, treat the die result as a 10 instead. The Croupier doesn't let you walk away from the table on the worst possible number.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Once per day, when you roll a natural 1 on a check/attack/save: treat the die result as a 10" is P-DIE: redefines the rolled die's own value rather than shifting a success tier or rerolling; no rule element does this, confirmed absent via exhaustive grep this pass.
